stem.text: A block is submerged vertically in a liquid. The four diagrams show the block viewed from the side.
Which diagram shows, to scale, the forces exerted on equal areas of the block by the liquid?

A.alt: Rectangle with arrows drawn on its top, bottom and both sides.

B.alt: Rectangle with arrows drawn on its top and bottom only.

C.alt: Rectangle with arrows drawn on its top, bottom and both sides.

D.alt: Rectangle with arrows drawn on its top, bottom and both sides.
